feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is stated for it. Iteration 1 (337.6, best) is the only array with 17 of 20 oval finishes, and iteration 2 showed that widening to ±0.06 m with 7 sensors raised oscillation from 0.20 to 0.37 and cut oval finishes to 4 of 20. So the sensing is reverted. Bend failures in iterations 0 to 2 all end at max_error about 0.06, the off-track limit, with rms_error about 0.025 to 0.03. That points to turn authority and reaction lag, not sensing. The Integrator has kept kp 2.5 and kd 0.4 and lowered base_speed to 1.7, because iteration 2 at 1.7 gave s-bend progress 0.316 against 0.236. Next race: if max_error on the s-bend and slalom falls below 0.06 and progress rises, keep wheel_track 0.09 and try the next step. If max_error stays at 0.06 with flat progress, narrow wheel_track to 0.08. If oval steering_oscillation rises above about 0.3, return wheel_track to 0.10 m, because the narrower track makes the same command turn harder.
requested_changes: If max_error on the s-bend and slalom stays at about 0.06 with s-bend progress still near 0.24 (iterations 0 and 1), narrow wheel_track from 0.09 to 0.08 m to raise turn authority further.

If steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.3 on the oval with wheel_track 0.09 (iteration 2 reached 0.37 with the wide array, iteration 1 was 0.20), return wheel_track to 0.10 m and keep the iteration 1 sensor array.

If line_loss_events stay at 1.0 per run on the slalom (iterations 0 to 1), keep the ±0.03 m, 0.015 m pitch array but move the row forward from y=0.07 to y=0.08 m for more lookahead, rather than widening the span again, which iteration 2 showed hurts oscillation.
